skills.name: aventure-cookbook
skills.description: Use for multi-step aVenture research recipes: company briefs, funding histories, round investors, investor portfolios, founder backgrounds, competitor sets, news monitoring, and resolving a list of names.

skills.name: aventure
skills.description: Use to read aVenture research data on private companies, founders, investors, funding rounds, and news through its API, CLI, or MCP server.

skills.name: competitive-landscape
skills.description: Use only when asked for a competitive landscape report on a company, product, or investment firm: the field within a stated boundary, player classes, the axes buyers trade off, a sourced player table, recent funding and M&A, unmet needs, and the subject's position.

skills.name: competitor-analysis
skills.description: Use only when asked for a competitor analysis of a company or product: head-to-head comparison with its closest rivals on product, total cost, customers, distribution, traction, economics, and team, with the subject's relative strength judged on evidence.

skills.name: investor-portfolio-analysis
skills.description: Use only when asked for a portfolio analysis of an investment firm or individual investor: funds, observed deal activity by year, stage, sector, and geography, lead and follow-on behavior with coverage stated, verified outcomes, co-investors, stated versus revealed thesis, and recent activity.

skills.name: leadership-track-record
skills.description: Use only when asked for a track record of a founder, executive, or investor: a verified, dated role history, outcomes during each tenure with careful attribution, board seats and investments, public record matters, and unverified claims flagged.

skills.name: market-research
skills.description: Use only when asked for a market research report on the market a company or product sells into: market boundary, size with shown arithmetic, growth, segments, buyers, pricing, regulation, and the subject's position.

skills.name: porters-five-forces
skills.description: Use only when asked for a Porter's Five Forces analysis of the industry a company or product competes in: a defined industry boundary, each force rated from structural evidence, its direction, the profit implication, and the subject's position.

skills.name: swot-analysis
skills.description: Use only when asked for a SWOT analysis of a company, product, or investment firm: internal strengths and weaknesses, external opportunities and threats, each specific and sourced, ranked for the reader's decision, and crossed into feasible actions.
